items.title: /v/ Video Games: “Nintendo’s game output is so much better than the Wii U and 3DS era!”
items.content_text: Is it REALLY better? If you compare Wii U by itself to Switch 2, then Switch 2 wins. But when you consider Nintendo’s total output at the time they were actually making way more games back then! This is the downside of dedicated portables dying off. Yes, Switch 2 has better third-party support… but nobody is actually buying third-party games on Switch 2, so does it really matter?

items.content_text: Play SpaceChem. Most of Zachtronics' games are great but this one is my favourite. It's chemistry autism, a lot of puzzle games are very constrained and just want you to fiddle forever to find a solution. This one gives you the rules, the requirements and tells you to find a solution yourself with the tools available, and it's really fun trying to optimise them. Story and soundtrack is pretty nice too.
